items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: I had been out of the suburban going to scowlting the band... So I got there and I talked to him back... Red Mackie had the band, I believe.

ctx.x: They liked me because I treated professors with respect and I acted like a professor. I didn't act like a jazz musician, you know what I mean? And I always got the job. That at Gulf Paul College. That's a good school. And we drive up there and I want to get there at least 45 minutes, half hour at a time. Couldn't get in. I have to wait until the professor come open the door and lock the door. Because they didn't want the kids to be inside. Same way at Ursula and Carmen. We drive up. It's no use to come on ahead…
